The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. The development comprises six towers and 778 residences. The architectural concept was created by Jacobs, while the interiors were designed by Kettle Collective. Sei Saadiyat is located in the heart of Saadiyat Cultural District, approximately 3 minutes from Abrahamic Family House, 4 minutes from Zayed National Museum, and around 5 minutes from Louvre Abu Dhabi, Manarat Al Saadiyat, Berklee Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Grove. Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi and teamLab Phenomena are about 7 minutes away, while Yas Island is around 20 minutes and Zayed International Airport approximately 25 minutes away. With approximately 78 sq m of space, the 1-bedroom format is well suited to owner-occupiers and buyers considering future rental within Saadiyat Cultural District. Its proximity to the island's major cultural landmarks is one of the project's defining advantages. Handover is scheduled for Q4 2030 . The payment plan is structured as 50/50 , with 5% payable on booking, 45% during construction and the remaining 50% on handover. A key advantage of Sei Saadiyat is the combination of an Aldar development, a prime cultural district location and a distinctive architectural concept. description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: The development features an exclusive collection of penthouses located on the highest levels, designed to offer a refined lifestyle, panoramic views and an unparalleled residential experience. Located by the sea and integrated in one of the most prestigious points of Dubai Harbour, the development is distinguished by its contemporary architecture, sophisticated interiors and a selection of rare and wide typologies. The five-bedroom penthouses, spread across levels 60 and 61, offer 180-degree views that span Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, Jbr Beach, Marina Skyline, Dubai Harbour and the open sea. These units have large living and lounge rooms, large dining room, main kitchen and kitchen, private office, home cinema, gym, pool on the balcony, bedrooms with walk-in closet, full service areas and generous balconies that enhance the view and natural light. Total unit areas range between about 7,800 and 8,600 sq.ft, including balconies and outdoor storage spaces. The units located on floors 6001 and 6101 have the same typology, distinguished mainly by the small variations in indoor and outdoor area, always maintaining large suites, spacious living areas and privileged views over the sea and the city. Units 6002 and 6102, also with five bedrooms, offer a similar configuration, with subtle differences in the size of the main rooms and leisure spaces, preserving the same level of finish and comfort characteristic of the development. On level 62 is a six-bedroom penthouse with 360-degree views over the entire city. This unit features two master suites with walk-in closet and spa-type bathrooms, cinema room, gym, sauna, hammam, wine room, bar, several living and dining rooms, three separate kitchens, private office, safe room, additional bedrooms with private bathrooms, full service area and multiple storage spaces. With more than 19,000 sq.ft total, it represents one of the most imposing and exclusive units in the development. On the 63rd level is another six-bedroom penthouse, with a similar but even wider layout, with total areas exceeding 19,800 sq.ft. This unit also enjoys completely unobstructed views, multiple social environments, spacious suites, technical and service areas, as well as generous outdoor spaces, designed to provide privacy, comfort and elegance. The finishes present in all units reflect the high standard of the development. The bathrooms include smart toilets and equipment from well-known brands, with premium finish furniture. The kitchens are fully equipped with high-performance appliances, cabinetry in durable materials and double sink. The development also offers several exclusive amenities, such as private outdoor cabanas, Bbq areas, outdoor living areas, leisure spaces and wellness environments integrated into carefully designed green areas. The development redefines the concept of seaside living in Dubai Harbour, combining spaciousness, privacy, excellent finishes and extraordinary views, resulting in a residential offering of true distinction.
